question: (a) For which graphs G on s vertices and which N does the complex of partial proper N-colourings, Ind(G □ K_N), have no hole in dimension s-2? Is N >= 2s-1 always enough, as Björner, Lovász, Vrećica and Živaljević prove for the complete graph? (b) For non-N-colourable graphs, how close is the Nullstellensatz degree of the functional colouring system over GF(2) to one more than B_hole, the largest B such that every vertex set S with 2 <= |S| <= B has no hole in dimension |S|-2?

public_inputs.universality: every graph on s = 2, 3, 4, 5 vertices up to isomorphism, with N = 2 .. 2s+1 colours
public_inputs.colouring_system: variables X_vc; Boolean; X_vc X_vc' (c != c'); X_uc X_vc for uv in E; sum_c X_vc - 1 for each v
public_inputs.degree_budget: Nullstellensatz degree searched for B = 1 .. 7, or until the moment system exceeds 400000 unknowns

forbidden_inputs: the expected verdicts as inputs to the producer
any precomputed homology or degree values

definitions.hole_in_dimension_d: nonzero reduced GF(2) homology in dimension d
definitions.B_hole: largest B such that every vertex set S with 2 <= |S| <= B has H~_{|S|-2}(Ind(G[S] □ K_N); GF(2)) = 0
definitions.NS_degree: least B such that no linear functional with value 1 on the constant annihilates the degree-B Nullstellensatz span, equivalently the moment equations (z_empty = 1; for |T| < B and v outside T, the sum over colours c allowed at v of z_{T+(v,c)} equals z_T) have no solution over GF(2)
definitions.theorem_check: the cycle-filling argument of Braun's Theorem 4.2, with the chessboard complex replaced by the partial-colouring complex, implies NS_degree > B_hole; a violation means a bug or a flaw in that argument

primary_observable: per graph and N: dim H~_{s-2}; per roster entry: B_hole, NS_degree and the slack NS_degree - 1 - B_hole
cheapest_meaningful_control: complete graphs K_s must have a hole in dimension s-2 at N = 2s-2 and none at N = 2s-1 (Shareshian and Wachs; Björner, Lovász, Vrećica and Živaljević); the odd cycle with two colours must have a hole already at s = 2
decision_or_followup_rule: Signal: no hole once N >= 2s-1 for every graph tested, and NS_degree > B_hole on the whole roster with small slack on most entries. A signal earns a proof ticket for the criterion and a bit-colouring probe. A violation of NS_degree > B_hole stops the run as a bug or flaw to investigate.
first_executable_signal: K5 at N = 8 and N = 9, then the universality sweep, then the roster
stop_rule: Stop on the first NS_degree <= B_hole; otherwise stop after the frozen roster and degree budget.
nonclaims: Finite enumeration on the declared graphs only; no asymptotic claim.
The functional unary encoding over GF(2) only; nothing about the bit encoding or Res(⊕) yet.
Nullstellensatz degree, not polynomial-calculus degree, unless they coincide by a separate argument.
